_comment: Cotton single jersey, undyed (Phase07 7.5): a T-shirt's knit. OPAQUE with FUZZ: a cotton knit's look is its loose surface fibres, which catch light at grazing angles. The knit (12 wales x 16 courses per cm) is the article's own normal and roughness. Off-white yarn: a Creator dyes it with `base_color_tint`.
